cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(Absolute-Compiler LANGUAGES CXX)

# Устанавливаем стандарт C++
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# The compiler used to build Absolute and the driver used to link programs
# generated by Absolute are usually the same. Some hosts, notably macOS, need
# Apple Clang for the project build but the LLVM SDK's clang++ for a matching
# sanitizer runtime. Keep that distinction explicit instead of relying on PATH.
set(ABSOLUTE_NATIVE_CXX_COMPILER "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}" CACHE FILEPATH
    "C++ driver used to link native programs emitted by Absolute")
set(ABSOLUTE_NATIVE_LINKER "${CMAKE_LINKER}" CACHE FILEPATH
    "Native linker used for Absolute-generated programs on Windows")

# Включаем расширенные предупреждения
if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/W4 /permissive-)  # Включаем предупреждения для MSVC
else()
    add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)  # Для других компиляторов
endif()

# Добавляем исполняемый файл
add_executable(Absolute-Compiler 
    src/entrypoint.cpp
    src/Absolute-Compiler.cpp
    src/plugin_loader.cpp
    src/package_manager.cpp
    src/pch.cpp
)

# Keep the existing compiler implementation intact while the public entrypoint
# injects project-level target settings before normal command-line parsing.
set_source_files_properties(src/Absolute-Compiler.cpp PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "main=absolute_compiler_main"
)

# Подключаем предкомпилированный заголовок (pch)
target_precompile_headers(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE include/pch.h)

# Подключаем заголовочные файлы
target_include_directories(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
    include
    ../Absolute-Parser/include
    ../Absolute-Analyzer/include
)

# Линкуем библиотеки
target_link_libraries(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE Absolute-Parser Absolute-Analyzer)
target_link_libraries(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(TARGET Absolute-CodeGen)
    target_link_libraries(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE Absolute-CodeGen)
    target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
        ABSOLUTE_HAS_LLVM=1
        ABSOLUTE_HOST_CXX_COMPILER="${ABSOLUTE_NATIVE_CXX_COMPILER}"
        ABSOLUTE_HOST_LINKER="${ABSOLUTE_NATIVE_LINKER}"
        ABSOLUTE_RUNTIME_LIBRARY="$<TARGET_FILE:Absolute-Runtime>"
    )
    if(CMAKE_DL_LIBS)
        target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
            ABSOLUTE_RUNTIME_DL_LIBRARY="${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}"
        )
    endif()
    if(ANDROID OR DEFINED ENV{TERMUX_VERSION})
        # Absolute-Runtime is a static archive. Its libucontext dependency must
        # also be present when absolutec links a generated native executable or
        # shared library; CMake's transitive target link does not participate in
        # that separate compiler-driver invocation.
        target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
            ABSOLUTE_RUNTIME_UCONTEXT_LIBRARY="ucontext"
        )
    endif()
    # Prefer the LLVM SDK that Absolute was configured against.
    # Do not pick Windows PE wasm-ld.exe when configuring under Linux/WSL.
    set(_absolute_wasm_ld_hints)
    if(DEFINED LLVM_TOOLS_BINARY_DIR AND LLVM_TOOLS_BINARY_DIR)
        list(APPEND _absolute_wasm_ld_hints "${LLVM_TOOLS_BINARY_DIR}")
    endif()
    list(APPEND _absolute_wasm_ld_hints
        "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.absolute/toolchains/llvm-18.1.8/bin"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.absolute/toolchains/llvm-18.1.8/bin")
    if(WIN32)
        find_program(ABSOLUTE_WASM_LD NAMES wasm-ld wasm-ld.exe
            HINTS ${_absolute_wasm_ld_hints})
    else()
        find_program(ABSOLUTE_WASM_LD NAMES wasm-ld
            HINTS ${_absolute_wasm_ld_hints})
    endif()
    if(ABSOLUTE_WASM_LD)
        target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
            ABSOLUTE_WASM_LD="${ABSOLUTE_WASM_LD}")
        message(STATUS "wasm-ld for Absolute: ${ABSOLUTE_WASM_LD}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "wasm-ld not found; WebAssembly --build-exe will search PATH at runtime")
    endif()
    if(ABSOLUTE_WASM_SHIM_OBJECT)
        target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
            ABSOLUTE_WASM_SHIM_OBJECT="${ABSOLUTE_WASM_SHIM_OBJECT}")
        if(TARGET Absolute-Runtime-WasmShim)
            add_dependencies(Absolute-Compiler Absolute-Runtime-WasmShim)
        endif()
    endif()
    if(ABSOLUTE_WASM_WASI_OBJECT)
        target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
            ABSOLUTE_WASM_WASI_OBJECT="${ABSOLUTE_WASM_WASI_OBJECT}")
    endif()
    if(ABSOLUTE_WASM_SHARED_OBJECT)
        target_compile_definitions(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
            ABSOLUTE_WASM_SHARED_OBJECT="${ABSOLUTE_WASM_SHARED_OBJECT}")
    endif()
    add_dependencies(Absolute-Compiler Absolute-Runtime)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/Zi>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/O2>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/Zi>
    )
    target_link_options(Absolute-Compiler PRIVATE
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/PDB:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Debug/Absolute-Compiler.pdb>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/PDB:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Release/Absolute-Compiler.pdb>
    )
endif()

# Указание выходной директории для библиотек и исполняемых файлов
set_target_properties(Absolute-Compiler PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "absolutec"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>"
)
